scripts.verify: pnpm -r build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/admin typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/admin build && pnpm --filter @sellright/api test && pnpm --filter @sellright/api db:assert-rls && pnpm --filter @sellright/api db:assert-hand-written && pnpm --filter @sellright/api assert:shop-isolation
scripts.deps:check: pnpm outdated -r || true; pnpm --dir packages/admin outdated || true; pnpm --dir packages/storefront outdated || true
scripts.deps:audit: pnpm audit --prod && pnpm --dir packages/admin audit --prod && pnpm --dir packages/storefront audit --prod
scripts.deps:update: pnpm up -r && pnpm --dir packages/admin up && pnpm --dir packages/storefront up
scripts.deps:update:latest: pnpm up -r --latest && pnpm --dir packages/admin up --latest && pnpm --dir packages/storefront up --latest
